questions.stem_text:

human rights protection, democracy, etc)?

Peace, commerce, and honest friendship with all nations, entangling alliances with none'.

options.C: the increasing importance of economic instruments of foreign policy.

questions.stem_text: What was meant by the term 'New World Order'?

options.A: A new democratic internationalism led by the United States
options.B: A new balance of power between the US and China

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A new democratic internationalism led by the United States

questions.stem_text: What was the significance of the Gulf of Tonkin resolution?

options.A: It allowed the US to intensify its involvement in Vietnam
options.B: It illustrated the influence of public opinion on US foreign policy
options.C: It enhanced Congressional control over the Vietnam War
options.D: It curtailed US involvement in Vietnam

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It allowed the US to intensify its involvement in Vietnam
